name: implement-wpf-winforms-interop
prompt: Integrate a legacy Windows Forms camera control into a .NET 10 WPF application and define safe DPI, focus, lifetime, and disposal boundaries.
rubric: Treats the request as a WPF interoperability boundary rather than rejecting it as WinForms-only.
Addresses WindowsFormsHost or ElementHost, DPI, focus, airspace, threading, and disposal concerns.
Keeps vendor or native control ownership explicit and proposes Windows runtime validation.
